bootstrap: 2000 deterministic whole-block resamples; unresolved sustained crossings remain right-censored; medians use the ordinary empirical median with infinity for unresolved values, never substituted horizon counts.
by_construction:
**By construction** (report for scale only):
1. With frames, P and L choose differently only on records where a value other than k is cued first and served at 1. One such record gives about 5 nats, so frame-aware P-against-L separation arrives with the first one (pre-check medians 6 and 5.5 records).
2. L takes a k-at-1 option with probability at least 0.98, while A gives it only its softmax share: the sharpness gap E1 used.
3. P equals L when no competing value is ever cued.
4. A and L ignore frames.
5. Lexicographic choices on conflict menus reveal k.
6. Inside the case region, check 3 makes "preemptive identity misread as compensatory" all but impossible by 64 records. The pre-checks found 0% to 1.6%.
7. Inside the case region, the frame-blind reader is expected to need fewer than 64 records. The pre-checks found 12 to 19 records across passing cells, so the registered verdict, "the frame is not needed", is expected by design. "Needed" appears only in the rare-cue out-of-case maps.
interpretation: Constructed method; miniature, architecture untested; no human inference or confirmation.
intervals: Pointwise 95% Student-t intervals for block means; block-percentile intervals for medians, median differences/ratios, and conditional proportions. All bars use the complete interval. No simultaneous or confirmation claim.
modelling_choices: Provisional grid sampling is uniform within each true type, with equal reader type priors. Menus draw each graded component independently and then overwrite specialist options. One independent maker draw per nested slot; eight per block in primary and four in texture. Ps is an additional reader type with the cell-fixed precedence strength and replaces P only in the generator. Best compensatory match minimizes mean total variation over all records. Case check uses 96 excluded makers and 512 records; floor applies to pooled mean record shares; world shares are reported.
question: How many records reveal preemptive identity with and without the frame?
